set.title: Utopia: The Creation of a Nation

set.note: Warren Robinett's Atari 2600 quest pioneered item-carrying exploration and hid his name in a secret room — one of the first video game Easter eggs.

editLinks.took: Warcraft's nine character classes, its best-known heroes and its art style.

editLinks.extra: Mizobe called Pokémon a great predecessor while likening Palworld's mechanics to ARK; Nintendo sued Pocketpair over gameplay patents in 2024.

_minor: Real, sourced links that are not about game design (pricing, business model). Shown on pages, skipped when picking a game's main line of roots.

addLinks.took: Lara Croft, tombs, climbing and ancient puzzles.
addLinks.added: A grittier origin story with survival, crafting and cinematic set pieces.
addLinks.extra: A reboot of the series by Crystal Dynamics.

addLinks.took: The rebooted Lara, her survival skills and the hub-based world.
addLinks.added: Bigger hubs, optional tombs and a Siberian expedition.

addLinks.took: Eight world warriors, six-button specials and combo timing from the 1991 arcade cabinet.
addLinks.added: Brought arcade head-to-head fighting home on the SNES, selling over six million cartridges.

addLinks.took: Wireframe 3D spaceflight and free-roaming player freedom pioneered on 8-bit home computers.
addLinks.added: Brought the free-roaming 3D world down onto a planet surface with buildings, vehicles and rival factions.

addLinks.took: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six popularized realistic squad tactics where one bullet can end a mission.
addLinks.added: Moved tactical infantry combat out of tight buildings onto open islands with tanks and helicopters.

addLinks.took: Long-range outdoor military firefights across wide open terrain.
addLinks.added: Combined-arms Cold War simulation with vehicles, squad orders and a mission editor.
